sentence: This project builds a tool that alters epigenetic marks on genes disrupted by opioid in specific neuron subtypes and tests it in the brain.
This project tries to find out how inflammation leaves a lasting memory in human epithelial cells.
This project uses directed evolution to build capsids that improve gene therapy for muscular dystrophies.
This project tests whether magnetic resonance imaging can give skull images like CT without harmful radiation for children.
This project builds statistical methods that estimate the mix of cell types in clinical samples for each individual.
This project studies how carbonyls change proteins in muscle of aging mice and in human plasma, using mass spectrometry.
This project builds an automated platform that checks quality during cell therapy manufacturing in real time without human intervention.
This project uses an animal model of combat-related trauma to find out how an inflammatory molecule in the locus coeruleus affects hyperarousal.
This project studies how inherited genetic variants let mutant clones of blood forming stem cells cause myeloproliferative neoplasms.
This project tries to find out whether human breast milk sugars can prevent disease caused by Streptococcus agalactiae.
This project offers methods that measure sphingolipids and track the enzymes that metabolize them, using targeted mass spectrometry.
This project studies oscillatory neural activity recorded with electrodes during deep brain stimulation surgery for Parkinson Disease.
This project studies how Staphylococcus aureus making nitric oxide changes its own metabolism and its ability to cause disease.
This project uses a model organism to find out how patient mutations stop a protein from working normally in Alternating Hemiplegia of Childhood.
This project uses genetically diverse mice to study how diet and the skin microbiome affect psoriasiform inflammation.
This project develops tools that use natural language processing technology to quickly assess how well teams work in children's mental health services.
This project builds AI tools that interpret serial 2D whole slide images of kidney tissue in 3D.
This project builds and maintains breast tumor lines from patients to test therapeutics in animal preclinical trials.
This project uses magnetic resonance with machine learning and quantum computing to study how large biological molecules move.
This project studies how cytomegalovirus infection affects placental macrophages and how the virus crosses the placenta to infect the fetus.
